output.one_liner: Ramp is an accounting and expense management platform for managing corporate cards, bills, purchase orders, and spending.

auth.notes: OAuth2 is the sole auth scheme. All three grant types are required; without refresh_token grant, connections become inactive when access token expires.

evidence.snippet: turn on Authorization code, Client credentials, and Refresh token. Without the refresh token grant, connections stop working when the access token expires.

access.notes: Pages reference demo.ramp.com environment and walk through OAuth app registration but do not state whether free developer accounts or unrestricted demo access exist without payment or approval.

evidence.snippet: If you registered the app on a Ramp demo account your browser shows demo.ramp.com use the demo-api.ramp.com and demo.ramp.com hosts instead.
